Hi Ellis / Sofia — thanks for the heads up. Good catch on the DST mismatch week.

Quick thoughts:
- For a single 60-minute demo that maximizes live coverage across EMEA/US/APAC, we typically propose either an early US window (~7:00 AM PT / 10:00 AM ET) which is mid/late afternoon in EMEA and evening in APAC, or a late US window (~2:00 PM PT / 5:00 PM ET) which is evening in EMEA and very late in APAC. Neither is perfect for APAC.
- Because the US falls back on Nov 3, any invites that cross midnight UTC during that week can flip local times for participants depending on their calendar client. My recommendation: pick a slot that falls fully within the same UTC day (e.g., 14:00-15:00 UTC) so each participant's local date is stable regardless of the DST boundary.

Proposed slots (all expressed in UTC for clarity):
1) 14:00-15:00 UTC — US (10:00 ET / 07:00 PT), UK (14:00), CET (15:00), APAC (23:00 AEDT)
2) 16:00-17:00 UTC — US (12:00 ET), UK (16:00), CET (17:00), APAC (01:00+1)

If APAC needs an earlier local window, we can split into two shorter sessions (EMEA+US live + APAC on a mirrored recording + Q&A at a follow-on time).

I can update the invite if you confirm preference. I pulled a quick mutual-action plan and attached it for procurement review as well.

Calendar proposal: https://cal.com/redwood/demo/finserve-slot
